title: [OC] Hybrid Game with Realtime World Model (with open sourced code)
author: realimposter
selftext: This is the result of combining a 2d game with a world model. World models can generate almost anything you prompt, but to make a game you still need memory, variables, scores, characters, scenes, etc. This game, and engine behind it is opened sourced so you can test it out: [https://github.com/sequencer-media/genesis](https://github.com/sequencer-media/genesis)
